✓ Demo reloads offline after your first visit
✓ No product account or telemetry
✓ Free under the MIT License
HOW IT WORKS
THREE FOLDERS, ONE SYNC READING
The observer checks sync status without handling your files.

SYNC STATUS CHECK

Why one sync reading helps

After reconnecting, “idle” may not mean every device agrees. The observer combines Syncthing status with conflict-copy names and explains missing checks.

HOW IT WORKS

How the observer checks a source
01
Add a local source

Add Syncthing on this computer or choose a folder. Credentials and paths stay in the app’s local storage.

02
Check the status and its limits

See pending counts, conflict-copy names, the last good check, and any details Syncthing did not report.

03
Open the sync tool

Open Syncthing from the affected row. The observer uses read-only checks and does not change your files.

DEMO WALKTHROUGH

Sample conflict walkthrough
1. Start with no sync status
The empty board waits for a local source before it reports a status.
2. Add a local source
Add Syncthing on this computer or choose a folder.
3. Check the status and its limits
The board shows the conflict and lists the checks it used.

STATUS LIMITS

When the reading is unknown

If a check cannot show that syncing finished, the board says so. Every status lists its checks and any missing Syncthing details.

↳ A folder check can find common conflict copies. Only Syncthing’s pending count can establish “Converged.”

CURRENT COVERAGE

Provider coverage and limits
ST
Syncthing

Reads Syncthing’s local folder list and pending-file count. It also checks folder names for conflict copies.

Can show when syncing finished
FS
Any local folder

Reads names, sizes, and timestamps only, capped at 50,000 entries and 16 levels. Never opens file content.

Conflict hints; convergence unknown
+
Other sync tools

Use a folder check to find common conflict-copy names. It cannot report files waiting in the sync tool.

Finished syncing stays unknown

INSTALL THE OBSERVER

Install Local Sync Observer

Choose a build for your operating system.

macOS

Apple silicon and Intel disk images.

Download .dmg from GitHub
curl -fsSL https://local-sync-observer.sociobot.in/install.sh | sh
Windows

64-bit Windows installer.

Download .msi from GitHub
irm https://local-sync-observer.sociobot.in/install.ps1 | iex
Linux

AppImage and Debian package.

Download .AppImage from GitHub
curl -fsSL https://local-sync-observer.sociobot.in/install.sh | sh

The macOS and Linux shell installer checks the downloaded file before opening it.
